bramble.name: Bramble
bramble.behaviour: Sits still like a bush. When you come close it curls up and rolls straight at you; it cannot turn, so step aside. It hurts to touch, even to hit bare-handed: use a tool.

mossback.name: Mossback
mossback.behaviour: Looks exactly like a mossy rock and never moves while watched from afar. Mine it or walk past and it wakes, stands on four stubby feet and shoves you back. Slow, very tough. Sleeps again if left alone.

flit.name: Flit
flit.where: caves, and above ground on dark nights
flit.behaviour: Hangs asleep from cave ceilings. Light or noise wakes the colony; they circle, then swoop one at a time and snatch food from your hands. Afraid of fire: a torch or a campfire keeps them off.

stats.speed: fast, flies over walls and water

glub.name: Glub
glub.behaviour: Sits half in the water and croaks. Anything that walks within three tiles gets a lash of its tongue, which also yanks small items out of your hands and into the water. It never chases.

pilfer.name: Pilfer
pilfer.behaviour: Does not fight. Sneaks to unlocked chests, mailboxes and dropped items, takes one thing and runs for its den. Catch it before it gets home and it drops the lot. Fences and closed doors stop it; it fits through open gates.

emberling.name: Emberling
emberling.where: born from campfires and burning things
emberling.when: any time a fire is left untended
emberling.behaviour: A fire nobody feeds for a night hops out of its ring. It wanders toward wood: fences, walls, crops, trees, and sets alight what it touches. Water puts it out at once; rain kills it. It never attacks people on purpose.

cairn.name: Cairn
cairn.behaviour: A heap of boulders in a wide chamber. Dig too close and it stands up. It walks slowly, raises both fists and slams: the shock breaks blocks around it and knocks you back, so walls do not save you. Its fists are stuck for a moment after each slam: that is when to strike the mossy head. Defeated, it falls back into a heap, and the ore it sat on is yours.
